A '''planet''' was located in a [[Unidentified Corva sector star system|star system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]]. [[Titan Base]] was a secret [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] base the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had built into a mesa on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was used to launch Rebel operations in adjacent [[Sector/Legends|sectors]].

At some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a team of Rebel agents was [[Transport/Legends|transported]] to the planet, where Titan Base's [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] briefed the group on a [[Operation: Shell Game|mission]] to retrieve an [[Project Shell-cracker|experimental]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Patrol boat/Legends|starship]] [[Shell-cracker prototype|prototype]] from the [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] [[FireStar-class Orbital Defense Station|space station]] [[HM7-R]]. The team was provided with forged credentials to infiltrate the [[Space station/Legends|station]] and left Titan Base aboard a captured Imperial [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], ''[[The Emperor's Vision]]''.

==Description==
A terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was located in a remote [[Unidentified Corva sector star system|star system]] in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]], a part of<ref name="OSG" /> the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The planet's surface featured a mesa and a large subterranean [[Cave/Legends|cavern]].<ref name="OSG" />

==History==
===Secret Corva sector base===
{{Quote|Titan Base's Special Operations team is missing in action, and none of our other local assets are available.|Commander Elemack, to a team of Rebel agents|<ref name="OSG" />}}
[[File:Corva-EAOC.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The Rebel Alliance maintained Titan Base on a planet in the Corva sector.]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the Alliance operated a hidden [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] base, known as [[Titan Base]], on the planet. It housed the [[Nightmare Squadron]] of [[T-65B X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65B X-wing starfighters]], as well as a resident [[Alliance Special Operations/Legends|Alliance Special Operations]] team&mdash;assets which were primarily used to conduct missions in adjacent [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] in order to avoid drawing Imperial attention to the presence of the Rebel base.<ref name="OSG" />

The Titan Base Special Operations team was captured by the Empire at some point following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and [[Prison/Legends|detained]] aboard the Corva sector [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial military]] [[FireStar-class Orbital Defense Station|space station]] [[HM7-R]], also known as "the Hammer." Approximately two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] later, [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] learned of the existence of [[Project Shell-cracker]], an Imperial weapons initiative developing a small-scale [[Shell-cracker prototype|bomber starship]] that could circumvent the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] of large-scale Rebel targets such as bases and [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] before delivering a payload of high-yield [[Hull/Legends|hull]]-shattering bombs. The prototype of the experimental [[Patrol boat/Legends|starship]] had also been moved to the Hammer for end stage testing.<ref name="OSG" />

===Operation: Shell Game===
{{RPG|"[[Operation: Shell Game (adventure)|Operation: Shell Game]]"}}
{{Quote|Your mission is to infiltrate the Hammer, discover the nature of Project: Shell-cracker, and then steal the prototype. If taking it intact proves impossible, then you are to destroy it at all costs. Whatever the outcome, we cannot permit a weapon of this nature, whatever that nature might be, to remain within the hands of the Empire. Questions?|Commander Elemack, to a team of Rebel agents|<ref name="OSG" />}}
The Alliance was determined to either retrieve the prototype of the [[starship]] or destroy it if capture proved impossible. However, the brief period of [[Time/Legends|time]] during which the vessel was scheduled to be tested at the Hammer severely limited the ability of Titan Base, one of the closest Rebel bases to the Hammer, to mobilize its top [[operative]]s. As a result, a relatively untested team, consisting of<ref name="OSG" /> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]]<ref name="Rescue">''[[Rescue at Glare Peak]]''</ref> [[Jaxon Brand]]; [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Gorbek Fask]]; the [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Lelsk]]; the [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Dero Jin]]; the [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Doleth Arnoko]]; and [[RA-7-D]], a [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|droid]] serving as an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] and a [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]],<ref name="Beta">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beta|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Beta]]</ref> was recruited for the [[Operation: Shell Game|mission]].<ref name="OSG" />

[[File:Jaxon_Brand.png|thumb|right|200px|A team including Lieutenant Jaxon Brand was dispatched on Operation: Shell Game from the planet housing Titan Base.]]
A two-[[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] trip aboard an Alliance [[Transport/Legends|transport]] took the Rebel team from a minor world's [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] to the planet housing Titan Base. While waiting for their briefing to begin, the agents visited several locations within the base and conversed with the Alliance personnel therein. Eventually, the team was summoned to the Titan Base's [[command center]], where the agents were briefed on their mission by the base's commander [[Elemack]] and other members of Titan Base's [[Commanding officer/Legends|command structure]].<ref name="OSG" />

The team was then provided with a captured [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], ''[[The Emperor's Vision]]'', as well as forged credentials that would allow the agents to infiltrate the Hammer. In addition, the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-M5 (Rebel Alliance)|R2-M5]] accompanied the team in order to hide Titan Base's location in the shuttle's [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]] as a precaution against Imperial inspection. Finally, the Rebel team traveled to [[the Hammer's system]], the group's departure from Titan Base coinciding with that of Nightmare Squadron, which would serve as the team's escort during the mission.<ref name="OSG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|I'm Lt. Shara, Logistics Officer. You've got a briefing in ten minutes, but I'd bet my pay that it's going to be at least a half-hour before the brass is ready.|Lieutenant [[Shara (Titan Base)|Shara]], to a team of Rebel agents|<ref name="OSG" />}}
The only inhabitants on the planet housing Titan Base were the [[Alliance Military/Legends|military]] base's personnel, which consisted of its command staff, [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], ground [[Trooper/Legends|troops]], [[Technician/Legends|mechanics]], and [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The non-mechanical Rebels at the base included members of various [[Species/Legends|species]], such as [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Near-Human]]s, [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], and [[Gotal/Legends|Gotals]].<ref name="OSG" />

==Locations==
{{Main|Titan Base}}
{{Quote|In the meantime, get some food, grab a rest or shower in the barracks, or whatever. Just stay out of the way.|Lieutenant Shara, to a team of Rebel agents|<ref name="OSG" />}}
Titan Base was a mostly subterranean starfighter base that had been built into a mesa. It featured a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bay]], [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]], and a command center. In addition, a weapons range had been established in a large natural cavern located beneath the base itself.<ref name="OSG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet appeared in the [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying game]] adventure "[[Operation: Shell Game (adventure)|Operation: Shell Game]]." It was included in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beta|Beta edition]] of the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]]. This article assumes the adventure plays out as described.<ref name="OSG" />
